title: regional-promotion-simulator-and-restore-audit
creator: Avery Chen
description: Goal: Build and run a repeatable, low-risk regional promotion simulator that performs a full active-promotion rehearsal against a copied dataset and validates backup/restore integrity, SLO burn behavior, and circuit-breaker/load-shedding responses. This ticket covers: 1) a dry-run promotion harness that routes a small percentage of synthetic and replayed production traffic to a quarantined passive region, 2) automated KV snapshot integrity checks and checksum-based restore validation, 3) a post-rehearsal SLO/regression audit comparing p50/p95/p99 latency and error budget burn to baseline, and 4) exercise of circuit-breaker and load-shedding gates (both ingress and model-serving) to validate rollback hooks.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible CLI/Orchestrator job (promotion-sim) can be scheduled and executed by on-call without touching production routing rules
Automated validation reports are generated and uploaded to the DR dashboard: includes KV snapshot hash mismatches, per-route latency percentiles, error budget changes, and model-serving error rates
Circuit-breaker thresholds trigger simulated partial throttles and the system executes the configured fallback (model-variant or queued degrade) and the event shows up in the Console tracing view
Restore-from-backup completes and checksum comparison shows 0 mismatches for critical namespaces (tokenstore, model-metadata, request-logs sample) OR all mismatches are triaged and documented
Playbook documents clear rollback path and escalation matrix; run finishes within scheduled maintenance window with <5% customer-impact window for reads (writes are isolated in rehearsal)
steps: Preflight: create rehearsal cluster in passive region with same runtime-1.20 image and node sizing; snapshot existing passive region state and duplicate to rehearsal namespace
Snapshot verification: take KV snapshots from primary; record SHA256 hashes per namespace; encrypt and store in rehearsal bucket
Restore step: boot rehearsal cluster, restore KV snapshots into isolated datastore, run schema and index migrations in dry-run mode
Traffic injection: start 1% synthetic + 0.1% replayed production traffic to rehearsal endpoint via traffic-funnel proxy; replay uses non-destructive read-only headers where possible
SLO monitoring: collect p50/p95/p99 latencies, 5xx rates, and request success rates; compute error budget burn over rehearsal period
Circuit-breaker exercise: lower circuit-breaker thresholds via feature-flag in rehearsal to trigger degradation; observe fallback behavior and tracing
Load-shedding test: enable progressive shedder that drops low-priority requests at defined load markers; verify priority queuing and responses
Checksum audit: after restore, run batch job comparing restored key counts and SHA256s against original snapshots and generate mismatch report
Canary promotion simulation: promote rehearsal control-plane to accept ephemeral writes for a small tenant, validate causal write fences and eventual reconciliation, then revert
Rollback: execute automated rollback playbook if mismatch > 0.1% for critical namespaces or SLO regressions exceed defined thresholds
Postmortem: upload logs, links to PRs and artifacts, and create follow-up action items
test_plan: Unit tests for promotion-sim CLI and restore-verifier (cover checksum, retry, timeout behavior)
Integration: end-to-end rehearsal on staging with synthetic traffic and mocked billing to ensure no accidental charges
Chaos test: in rehearsal, inject delayed disk IO for 30s to validate KV recovery and shedder behavior
Recovery test: intentionally corrupt one namespace file and confirm restore-verifier flags mismatch and triggers alert routing
monitoring_checks: DR Dashboard: rehearsal job status, step-level timestamps, and final verdict
SLOs: p99 latency <= baseline * 1.5, error rate increase <= 2x baseline for rehearsal window
Circuit-breaker events: count and reason codes surfaced in tracing and console
Resource signals: GPU memory pressure, CPU steal rate, disk IO saturation with thresholds and alerts
Backup integrity: snapshot age < 1h at time of rehearsal, SHA256 checksums present
rollback_plan: Immediate: stop traffic funnel, flip rehearsal routing back to passive-only, remove ephemeral writes
Restore: if checksum mismatches exceed threshold, re-run restore from previous known-good snapshot and re-run checksum job
Model fallback: switch to pre-configured model-variant in all regions if model-serving errors > threshold
Escalation: page SRE on-call -> DR lead -> VP Eng based on impact matrix in playbook
notes: Keep rehearsal keys isolated and rotate KMS key after rehearsal to avoid cross-environment confusion
This ticket intentionally avoids touching production routing tables; all promotion must be simulated via traffic-funnel proxy built for rehearsals
We will retain rehearsal artifacts for 30 days and then purge; include retention decision in compliance notes
Coordinate with Legal if any replayed PII is present — anonymize/reduce dataset as required
comments: 2026-03-03 — Avery Chen: Initial spike completed. Promotion-sim prototype can spin up rehearsal cluster in 12 minutes. Observed divergent index versions for model-metadata; adding migration dry-run step.

2026-03-05 — Ravi Kapoor: Implemented restore-verifier and checksum reporter. Early runs show tokenstore hash mismatches at 0.02% due to transient write ordering; planning to add final reconciliation pass and document acceptable delta thresholds.
2026-03-08 — SRE-Lead Maya Ortiz: Approved schedule for first rehearsal on 2026-03-21 during maintenance window. Confirmed on-call rotations and backup retention policy.
2026-03-10 — Security: flagged replayed traffic dataset for PII scanning. Action: add anonymization step to preflight and add legal coordinator to run list.
